decision: NX-030 D3 (owner 2026-10-10, all as recommended): default thresholds of design §2. Evaluated once a minute on the SQL snapshot, world 'real' only (D6); one alert per rule and selector, resolved when the condition clears; shown to the owner in the workbench (D2). metric is a dotted path into runtime.nexloop_metrics_snapshot; one '*' segment iterates its children (the child key becomes the selector); selector picks one key of a map. A new version is a new file.

rules.purpose: M01: model or incentive budget exhausted; new work is being refused.
M01: many dispatches refused for a stale control revision; reevaluation is not keeping up.
M01: many dispatches refused for a superseded goal version.
M02: an external result has been unknown for more than 15 minutes; query, never resend.
M02: an external result has been unknown for more than 2 hours.
M03: reconciliation left an effect unknown for more than 24 hours.
M04: a fallback reply failed or did not start (ADR-023: every inbound message gets a reply).
M05: a commitment passed its due date unfulfilled.
M05: a commitment was made to a contact-restricted customer.
M06: a queued task was dead-lettered.
M06: the oldest due task has waited more than 10 minutes.
M06: a work feed item was dead-lettered.
M06/M07: a work feed has waited more than 10 minutes.
M07: an accepted message has waited more than 30 minutes for extraction.
M08: more than 1% of guard calls hit the 2 s deadline in the last 5 minutes.
M08: guard p95 above 1500 ms, close to the 2 s deadline.
M09: a Run waited past the Agent Host admission window (runtime_capacity_exhausted).
M10: connection pool requests have been waiting for 5 minutes.
M10: more than 50 database connections (deployment limit 60).
M11: more than 80% of a budget used (the limit itself is enforced by NX-022).
M12: last backup older than 26 hours (wired when NX-035 provides the backup manifest; unavailable until then).
